description.en: Stage local 3D models with ready-to-use lighting presets, camera views and manual controls. Cherry AI is optional.
description.zh: 用现成灯光方案、快捷机位和手动微调为本地 3D 模型布景，无需配置 AI。

releaseNotes.en: Adds five local staging presets, four camera views, background choices and light controls, with validated, undoable scene changes and saved operation results.
releaseNotes.zh: 新增五套本地布景方案、四个快捷机位、背景与灯光微调；修改经过校验、可撤销，并保存真实提交结果。
